This Akshay Urja Diwas, Dr Jay Ganesh Pandey, Research Associate TERI, explajns the power of the clean kilowatt. From rooftop solar arrays to vast wind corridors, renewable energy is no longer an alternative, it is the foundation of our energy transition. Watch how we’re harnessing infinite natural power to build a resilient, decarbonized future.
